run_car_racing_bezier_env: run the CarRacingBezier gym environment with keyboard controls via argparse CLI with optional track name and seed
create_bezier_track: create a Bezier curve racetrack with configurable control points and border indicators in the Box2D world
create_polar_track: create a polar coordinate racetrack from random checkpoints with configurable minimum and maximum radius ratios
configure_sparse_rewards: configure sparse reward bins and goal tracking for the CarRacingBezier environment to reward reaching target track segments
render_car_racing_view: render the CarRacingBezier environment in human, rgb_array, state_pixels, level, or sketch mode with optional birdseye camera view
